data.name: Indraraht
data.gender_notes: Indraraht is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indraraht is a name derived from Hindu mythology. It is believed to mean 'King of Indra', Indra being the god of rain in Hinduism. In Islamic context, it can be considered as a symbol of power, authority and protection. The name Indraraht carries the meaning “King of Indra” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Indraraht usually hope their child will grow to embody king of indra and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength, courage and leadership qualities of an individual.
data.etymology: Indraraht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Indra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indraraht total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: اندراراہت
in_urdu.meaning: مشتق از سلطان و طاقت و ہدایت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اندراراہت ایک عربی نام ہے جو س-ل-ط-ن کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے سلطان، طاقت، اور ہدایت۔ یہ نام مضبوط اور حلیم شخصیت کی خصوصیت رکھتا ہے جو رہنمائی اور مشورے کی صلاحیت رکھتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इन्द्राराहत
in_hindi.meaning: सुलतान और शक्ति और मार्गदर्शन से लिया गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: इन्द्राराहत एक अरबी नाम है जो स-ल-ط-न के मूल से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है सुलतान, शक्ति, और मार्गदर्शन। यह नाम एक मजबूत और बुद्धिमान व्यक्तित्व का सुझाव देता है जो मार्गदर्शन और परामर्श करने में सक्षम है।

in_english.name: Indraraht
in_english.meaning: Derived from Sultan, power, and guidance
in_english.long_meaning: Indraraht is an Arabic-derived name originating from the root s-l-t-n, signifying Sultan, power, and guidance. It connotes a strong and wise personality with the ability to lead and counsel, embodying leadership qualities and spiritual guidance.

historical_references.reference: Indraraht was a king of the ancient Indian city of Indraprastha, mentioned in the Indian epic Mahabharata.
historical_references.context: Indraprastha was the capital city of the Pandava kings, and Indraraht was the eldest of the five brothers, Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, and Sahadeva.
